advancements.jaymoskingdoms.roads.root.d: Every start that's locked opens with a deed. Do it, and the road is yours for your next life.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.city.hint: Someone has to have made a name in a trade first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.wild.hint: Someone has to have seen a dawn far from any roof first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.sworn.hint: Someone has to have stood against raiders first.
